title: 第 2 章 不嫁裴砚
slug: 成婚不圆房重生娇娇不嫁他急了
content_zh:
他是中宫嫡出的长子，出生时被替换成了死胎，后来宫里出生的皆是公主，再无皇子。
梅夫人找过皇后娘娘，想为女儿求个恩典，可被皇后娘娘搪塞了过去。
梅夫人也与裴砚说过自己的担忧，裴砚表示，他会护着梅晚萤，但不会娶她。
梅晚萤撇开眼，纤细的手指抹去眼角的泪珠，“那我便不嫁，一辈子当老姑娘。”
情绪波动太大，梅夫人胸口起伏，“太子为人霸道，岂是你说不嫁就能应付的？”
content_en:
He was the eldest son of the royal family, but he was stillborn when he was born. Later, all the children born in the palace were princesses and no princes.
Mrs. Mei went to the Empress to ask for a favor for her daughter, but the Empress blocked her.
Mrs. Mei also told Pei Yan about her concerns, and Pei Yan said that he would protect Mei Wanying, but would not marry her.
Mei Wanying opened her eyes and wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes with her slender fingers, "Then I won't marry and will be an old girl for the rest of my life."
The mood swings were too great, and Mrs. Mei's chest heaved, "The prince is domineering, how can you handle it without marrying?"
